notes.title: Update #2 💥
notes.content:
New version update content:

 Fixed the issue where a certain section of "Burn it All" (Advanced) could not be performed when played with Bass.
 Fixed the issue where the MOD list could not be loaded due to downloading MODs with incorrect formats.
 Added different holding hand poses for Bass when pressing different buttons.
 Added an "Environment" volume adjustment option (e.g., lobby background music, cheers from the concert audience, etc.)
 Adjusted Beatmap's data format and loading method for the upcoming new editor.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update! 🧑‍🎤👨‍🎤👩‍🎤👨‍🎤
notes.content:
Winter has arrived, and the main scene has started to snow in anticipation of Christmas ❄️.

Four new official tracks have been added:

 Burn It All - David John Powell
 Ride Out - Matt Goodman
 Like A Wildfire - Violet Island
 Into The Water - Lost Portals


Multiplayer mode now supports MODs:

 By turning on the MOD switch on the homepage, you can vote for your subscribed MOD as the next song you want to play in the multiplayer room. When the next song is determined to be a MOD song, the same MOD will be automatically downloaded for everyone, and the game will start playing after the download is complete.
 Custom sorting conditions have been added to the MOD subscription list.
 The system now automatically identifies and disables the MODs that cannot be played due to missing or damaged files, preventing incorrect game loading.
 Fixed an issue where there was no vibration feedback from the controllers when interacting with the keyboard before the song started.
 Fixed an issue where some buttons in the MOD browser filter were incorrectly showing no results.
 Fixed an issue where some symbols were not displayed correctly in the MOD browser.

notes.title: 🎸 Band Space is OUT NOW 🎸
notes.content:
The stage is set, and it’s time to rock! Band Space is now live on SteamVR for $19.99, but for a limited time, you can grab with a 20% launch discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2182070/Band_Space/


Watch the new launch trailer below!
[previewyoutube=Ze6kmLA8i94;full][/previewyoutube]

Band Space is the VR game that lets you form your dream music group. Tune up and take the stage, mastering guitar, bass, drums and keyboard with up to four players.

Slide to catch notes, power through the drum beat, and dazzle with your keyboard. Smash through songs together in 5 different arenas, tackle a variety of tracks, and get the practice in with solo and mixed reality modes.

Key Features of Band Space Include:

 4 Instruments To Master: Practice riffs and licks on guitar and bass, lay down the beat on drums, dazzle the crowds on keyboard.
 Play Together Or Alone: Band together with up to three friends online and rock out as if you were really onstage. 
 A Range Of Songs, With More To Come: Enjoy a 30-track playlist, including music from renowned artists like Jason Bowld from Bullet For My Valentine, Johnny Lloyd from Tribes, and Thorr, composer for the latest entry in John Romero's Sigil series.
 Mod.io Integration: Enjoy mod support in single-player mode, allowing players to create, share, and play custom music. Multiplayer mod support is also in development.
 One Hand Mode: Hone your skills by focusing on the operation of one hand at a time. Choose the "Only Strum" mode to handle just the strumming, while the game takes care of the neck movements automatically. Choose the "Only Tracks" mode to practise your finger placement, while the game strums automatically.
 Dominant Hand Setting: Customize your play style by selecting your dominant hand, whether you're a lefty or a righty, for guitar and bass.


If you’re already rocking out in Band Space and loving the experience, leave us a review! It helps us out a lot. 

If you have any questions, hop over to our Discord where we will be more than happy to answer them!

- SmartMelon Games / Fast Travel Games

notes.title: The beatmap editor get a major update!
notes.content:
hey everybody,

We are so happy to tell you that the beatmap editor has been updated to a new version! The new editor supports importing MIDI files to generate game-runnable beatmap files. This means that if you want to play a song, you don't need to manually put the notes anymore, you only need to get the audio file on the Internet, and the corresponding MIDI file together will do the trick. Of course, the former manual editing method is still supported. For more detailed operation instructions, please refer to the “How to use” doc below. A brand new way to make your beatmap, try it now!

🛠 Download link：https://github.com/Smartmelon/BandSpace/releases

📙 How to use：https://smartmelon.github.io/BandSpace


New features
Generate beatmap with MIDI file

Bugfixes
fixed some notes can't be deleted when batch selected;
fixed some notes didn't duplicate correctly when batch selected;
fixed some notes can't be added in specific condition;
fixed when creating a folder with the same name would open the existing folder.

Feel free to share your completed sheet music on our Discord for everyone to experience and exchange. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions while using the editor, you can also provide feedback on Discord.

https://discord.com/invite/hZA9xsfYnn

notes.title: Band Space Released First Major Update: Cutomized Beatmap Editor!
notes.content:
Dear Resonancers!

Band Space is excited to announce our first major update: Customized Beatmap Editor!
This update includes:
Band Space betaV0.2.0
Beatmap EditorV0.1.0

With this update, players will no longer be caged with limited beatmaps. Instead, Band Space   encourages players to get creative and think-out-of-the-box with the Customized Beatmap Editor. Upload your favorite tracks and create your ideal maps in our multiverse!

Step by step:
1. Before you log into the lobby, click on the ‘Launch BS Beatmap Editor’ button.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43097298/4c1b627e0936227fbead2397ccf1b25f9195b900.jpg

2. Players can upload their favorite tracks and enter Beatmap Editor.
Click here to see tutorial to BS Beatmap Editor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43097298/4c7a04f5c7d8bb3267a98e4de6037e068d6a1165.png

Attention please! Players can not only save Beatmaps locally, they can also download Beatmaps and share them with fellow players! When receiving Beatmap files, simply drag them into designated location on your system and you will be able to play customized Beatmaps in your game! (Instructions see below)

Notification: The current version is a closed beta version, due to development needs, this update will remove your historical record, you will need to play the beginner tutorial again. Thanks a lot for your understanding for any inconvenience caused.
This Closed Beta version does not represent the final gameplay.
If you do enjoy our game, please add us to your Wishlist!🔥
